description: This file contains GPIO driver implementation for the RV32M1 microcontroller in the Zephyr RTOS, including configuration structures, GPIO pin configuration, interrupt handling, and device initialization.

methods.name: get_port_pcr_irqc_value_from_flags
methods.description: Determines the IRQ configuration value based on GPIO interrupt mode and trigger.

methods.name: gpio_rv32m1_configure
methods.description: Configures a GPIO pin with specified flags, including direction, pull-up/down, and interrupt settings.

methods.name: gpio_rv32m1_port_get_raw
methods.description: Reads the current raw input value of the GPIO port.

methods.name: gpio_rv32m1_port_set_masked_raw
methods.description: Sets multiple GPIO pins simultaneously based on mask and value.

methods.name: gpio_rv32m1_pin_interrupt_configure
methods.description: Configures interrupt mode and trigger for a specific GPIO pin.

methods.name: gpio_rv32m1_port_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for GPIO port, handles interrupt and invokes callbacks.

methods.name: gpio_rv32m1_init
methods.description: Initializes the GPIO device, enabling clock and setting up IRQ.
